missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Колено' is the neuter nominative subject of 'болит'. 'Правое' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'у меня' frames whose knee hurts. The basic complaint sentence.

missions.phrase: Я разбил колено во время игры.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Колено' is the neuter accusative direct object of 'разбил'; neuter nouns look the same in nominative and accusative. 'Во время игры' is the genitive time frame. A natural injury report.

Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На колене' uses the neuter prepositional 'колене' after 'на' to place the skin. 'Покраснела' agrees with the feminine subject 'кожа'. Useful for describing symptoms.

missions.phrase: Ребёнок сидит у мамы на коленях.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional plural idiom. 'На коленях' uses the neuter prepositional plural to mean a lap. 'У мамы' is the genitive of possession. The standard way to say sitting on someone's lap.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'На колено' uses the neuter accusative after 'на' to show the motion of kneeling. 'Одно' is the agreeing neuter numeral. Classic for a proposal scene.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Колено' is the neuter accusative object of 'осмотрел'. 'Моё больное' are the agreeing neuter modifiers. Good for a doctor's-visit context.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Колени' is the neuter nominative plural subject of 'дрожали'. 'После падения' is the genitive time frame. Vivid for describing fear or weakness.

Strategic focus: Accusative of placement. 'На колено' uses the neuter accusative after 'на' to mark where the hand goes. 'Руку' is the feminine accusative object of 'положил'. A clear motion-onto pattern.

missions.phrase: Боль в колене мешает мне бегать.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of location with dative. 'В колене' uses the neuter prepositional 'колене' after 'в'. 'Мне' is the dative experiencer of 'мешает'. Useful for explaining a limitation.

missions.phrase: Бабушка часто гладит внука по колену.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after 'по'. 'По колену' uses the neuter dative 'колену' to show the surface being stroked. 'Внука' is the masculine accusative object. A warm, everyday gesture.
